title: Erdős Sumset Conjecture: Gap Conditions and IP Sets
description: Explores gap conditions in the Erdős sumset conjecture (B+C subset of A). Defines syndetic, thick, piecewise syndetic sets. States gap-controlled sumset decomposition, syndetic sumset question, and connection to IP sets and Hindman's theorem.

meta.author: Lean Genius
meta.assumptions: 1 axiom: hindman_theorem (Hindman 1974 — every finite coloring of N has a monochromatic IP set). Deep result in Ramsey theory.
originalContributions: IsSyndetic, IsThick, IsPiecewiseSyndetic: gap condition definitions
SyndeticSumsetQuestion: open question about syndetic B
IsIPSet, IsIPStar: IP set and IP* set definitions
syndetic_infinite: proved syndetic sets are infinite
ip_set_sumset_structure: proved IP sets contain infinite B+C via odd/even index splitting
Corrected false claim: positive density does NOT imply containing an IP set

overview.historicalContext: The Erdős sumset conjecture was proved by Moreira-Richter-Robertson in 2019 using ergodic theory.
overview.problemStatement: Can the sets B, C in the sumset decomposition B+C ⊂ A be chosen with specific gap conditions?
overview.proofStrategy: Define gap conditions (syndetic, thick, piecewise syndetic), state the strengthened conjecture with arbitrary gap functions, and explore the connection to IP sets via Hindman's theorem.
keyInsights: Gap-controlled version (arbitrary gap function) is proved by MRR
Syndetic B is likely too strong — open question
IP sets provide a bridge between density and sumset structure
Positive density does NOT imply containing an IP set (mod 3 counterexample)
Correct relationship: positive density implies IP* (intersects every IP set)

conclusion.summary: Gap conditions formalized with 2 sorries eliminated and a mathematical error corrected. IP set sumset structure proved via odd/even index splitting.
conclusion.implications: Maps the landscape of strengthenings of the sumset conjecture, with corrected IP set theory.
openQuestions: Is the syndetic sumset question true or false?
Can the proof avoid ergodic theory?
Can posUpperDensity_piecewiseSyndetic be proved from Mathlib primitives?

crossReferences.description: Explores gap conditions for the sumset conjecture
